text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good morning, all. I believe you have heard the results by now…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But allow me to announce the results of the fan poll for this year's Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The honor of this year's number one spot goes to…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black. Congratulations. May you race your best on the track.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the official announcement of the Takarazuka Kinen's voting results, Tracen Academy goes wild.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer! We really did it!
choice_data_list: You're the most popular Umamusume now!
You're the most popular Umamusume now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I am… and I couldn't have done it without you! You helped me train and improve slowly but surely!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nobody would even give me a second glance back then, but now… I've got all these fans cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to all her fans' support, Kitasan Black can advance to the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best today, Brusquement!

text_block_list.name: Brusquement
text_block_list.text: …Sure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Last spring's jitters are back…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You know what, Trainer? I get the feeling I'll get answers to things I've never been able to understand if I run right now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, like what about Brusquement makes her so strong, and how I stack up against her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What aspects I've caught up to her on, and which ones I haven't. I'll have to work hard to reach her level on the things I'm still behind on…
choice_data_list: We have to be aware of what you don't need to work on as well.
We have to be aware of what you don't need to work on as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, what I don't have to work on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to Kitasan Black how each Umamusume has their own unique characteristics, but their quirks aren't what make or break them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no need to try to match Brusquement in what she's good at. All Kitasan Black must do is polish her own strengths.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is sound advice. Your trainer is correct. Umamusume all have different origins, and it's critical to locate that point in ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We must understand ourselves at the deepest level and discover the meaning of the blood flowing in our veins.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's meaning…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. You must maximize the potential of the legacy you carry. Only by doing that can you reach your final form and reach the epitome of glory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show me what you've got today, Kitasan Black. Show me what meaning lies within your blood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let me see just how much potential you have hidden inside you in your race against Brusquement.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This will be their first battle since entering their senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, they'll be able to see just what their rival is really made of.
